summary.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 桌面端从旧版本升级到 v0.48.0 后会话列表无法加载、消息无法发送的问题。
summary.en-US: Fixes Windows Desktop upgrades from older releases to v0.48.0 that could prevent sessions from loading and messages from sending.

body.zh-CN: 补齐旧版 Windows 桌面外壳启动新版运行时所需的兼容资源，升级后会话列表和消息发送可以重新连接本地运行时。
body.en-US: Ships the compatibility asset required when older Windows Desktop launchers start the new runtime, allowing session lists and message sending to reconnect after an upgrade.

body.zh-CN: 从已有本地历史恢复升级后缺失的会话目录和消息，同时保持用户已删除的会话不再显示。
body.en-US: Rebuilds missing session entries and messages from existing local history while keeping intentionally deleted sessions hidden.
